title: Rajasthan PTET Answer Key 2026
intro: Short Information : Vardhman Mahaveer Open University, MVOU Kota has released the answer key for the Rajasthan 2 Year B.Ed. Joint Entrance Examination 2026. Applications for the Rajasthan PTET Admission Online Form 2026 were accepted from 20 February 2026, to 20 March 2026. The entrance examination was held on 14 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Rajasthan PTET Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
